Messages.Author: Scott Shaw
Messages.Body:
Uhh.. quick question about vast wealth. Our playgroup has been
playing that this card is placed on a vampire which can then take +1
stealth actions to equip the first piece of equipment in the library.
the question is... when do other people have to decide whether to block...
before or after it is determined which piece of equipment will be
equipped?

We've been playing that you have to decide as soon as the vamp takes the
action which is before the point that the controlling player goes through
his/her library and finds the equipment. Is this correct?

Thanks in advance.

Scott

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Scott Shaw wrote:
>
> Uhh.. quick question about vast wealth. Our playgroup has been
> playing that this card is placed on a vampire which can then take +1
> stealth actions to equip the first piece of equipment in the library.
> the question is... when do other people have to decide whether to block...
> before or after it is determined which piece of equipment will be
> equipped?

Before. You do not go find a peice of equipment until the action is
successful (unblocked), since that is part of the successful action.

> We've been playing that you have to decide as soon as the vamp takes the
> action which is before the point that the controlling player goes through
> his/her library and finds the equipment. Is this correct?

Yes.
